gloss: to move around, to move about

definitions.gloss: to move around, to move about
definitions.explanation: To change position or location repeatedly, moving in various directions.

definitions.gloss: to be active, to be on the move
definitions.explanation: To be physically active, not staying still.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}が{庭|にわ}を{動|うご}き{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: The dog is moving around the yard.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{部屋|へや}の{中|なか}を{動|うご}き{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: The baby is moving around the room.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}をしたら、{動|うご}き{回|まわ}らないでください。
examples.english: If you're injured, please don't move around.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{公園|こうえん}であちこち{動|うご}き{回|まわ}って{遊|あそ}んでいた。
examples.english: The children were playing and moving around all over the park.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}の{後|あと}は{建物|たてもの}の{中|なか}をむやみに{動|うご}き{回|まわ}らない{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: After an earthquake, it's better not to move around carelessly inside the building.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}から{忙|いそが}しく{動|うご}き{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: I was busy and on the move since morning.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{落|お}ち{着|つ}かない{様子|ようす}で{動|うご}き{回|まわ}っていた。
examples.english: The cat was restlessly on the move.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{一日中|いちにちじゅう}{街|まち}の{中|なか}を{動|うご}き{回|まわ}っていた。
examples.english: He was on the move around town all day long.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}で{毎日|まいにち}あちこち{動|うご}き{回|まわ}らなければならないので、{体力|たいりょく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: I have to be on the move everywhere for work every day, so physical stamina is necessary.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}の{担当者|たんとうしゃ}は{朝|あさ}から{晩|ばん}まで{取引先|とりひきさき}を{動|うご}き{回|まわ}って、やっと{契約|けいやく}を{取|と}ることができた。
examples.english: The sales representative was on the move visiting clients from morning to night, and finally managed to close the deal.

notes:
{動|うご}き{回|まわ}る is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to move around.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {動|うご}く (to move) + {回|まわ}る (to go around) → to move around

ASPECT (ている):
{動|うご}き{回|まわ}っている indicates an ongoing state of moving around, often restlessly.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}かず{動|うご}き{回|まわ}る (move around restlessly)
- あちこち{動|うご}き{回|まわ}る (move around everywhere)
- {自由|じゆう}に{動|うご}き{回|まわ}る (move around freely)

USAGE NOTE:
More general than {歩|ある}き{回|まわ}る (walking) or {走|はし}り{回|まわ}る (running). Can be used for any kind of movement including crawling, shuffling, etc.

[Register: Neutral]
